notes.title: Everything to know about the game's release
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Blade Princes,

The clock is ticking and soon the doors of the Academy will open up to you! Before your first day of school, here are some information about the release that might be useful to you:

Game Pricing and support

Blade Prince Academy will be released on Steam March 7, 2024 for $19.99/19.99€/£16.75. 

Discover Abjectalia through missions that will send you accross the different sectors of this decadent city! After a hard day of work, find solace at the Academy and take care of the Blade Princes schedule : potion making, restful sleep at the Infirmary, parties, heart-to-heart talks in the gardens, pacts upgrades at the Black Mages Altar... Protect the city, get rid of enemies, create bonds and see the Blade Princes grow, for better or for worse.

The game will be supported on PC and Steamdeck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/fcf7a0871bb6031f072c5863c2b288b1f36f5f31.png

Game Localizations

Blade Prince Academy will be available in all of the languages cited below:

 French
 English
 Spanish
 German
 Brazilian Portuguese
 Simplified Chinese

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/144d44a8854c4b7dcaf10dde8edd8b2aa9c731ca.jpg

Release Timing

To see when the game is available in your time zone, please refer to the map below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/3cc11773cf162ac1b3e7f2a278857453eaaa3c0e.png

Thank you all fellow students and if you have any other questions on the game or its release, feel free to comment or reach out to us!

Enjoy your day Blade Princes and stay tuned for the upcoming news!

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -
